title: Vienna Game: Max Lange Defense
line: Black brings the other knight out first. White aims at f7 and keeps the pawn on f2 ready.

steps.text: The Vienna Game, and Black brings out the queen side knight: the Max Lange Defense. It guards the pawn on e5.
Bring the bishop out. It aims at f7, the square only Black's king guards.

also.g2g3: Making room for the bishop on the long diagonal is also sound. This lesson goes to c4.
also.g1f3: That leads to the Four Knights Game, also sound. This lesson brings the bishop out.
also.f2f4: The pawn push is also sound. This lesson brings the bishop out.

steps.after: Black's knight attacks your pawn on e4.

steps.text: Guard the pawn with the pawn in front of your queen. It also opens a line for your other bishop.
Bring the other knight out to e2. The pawn on f2 stays free to push later.

also.c4b3: Saving the bishop is also sound. This lesson lets Black take it.
also.d1f3: That is also sound. This lesson brings the knight out.

steps.text: Take back with the pawn. It covers d5 and b5, and the line for your queen opens.
steps.after: Black has the two bishops; you have a firm center and the push to f4 still to come.

steps.text: Back to the bishop move. If Black brings its bishop out instead of the king side knight, your queen can go after the pawn on g7.
Bring the queen to g4. She attacks the pawn on g7.

also.d2d3: That is also sound and played as often. This lesson goes after the pawn.

steps.after: Black guards with the pawn, and the dark squares by its king get weaker.

steps.text: Step the queen back to f3. With the bishop she now aims at f7.

also.g4g3: That is also sound. This lesson goes to f3.

steps.after: Black blocks with the knight. Your pieces are out and pressing.

summary: The bishop aims at the weak pawn by the king while the side pawn waits to push. An early queen trip can hit pawns too.
